name: Witch
description: A cunning hex-weaver who cripples enemies with curses, strips their defenses, and watches them wither under relentless afflictions.
lore: Witches practice the oldest and most feared form of magic — the art of the curse. Shunned by polite society but invaluable in a dungeon, they unravel an enemy's strengths thread by thread until nothing remains but a hollow shell.

abilities.name: Hex Bolt
abilities.description: Fires a bolt of cursed energy that deals 0.9x dark damage and slightly reduces the target's Magic DEF by 5% for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Curse of Weakness
abilities.description: Curses an enemy, reducing their Physical ATK and Magic ATK by 25% for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Enfeeble
abilities.description: Weakens a single enemy, reducing their Physical ATK and Magic ATK by 20% for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Venom Hex
abilities.description: Inflicts a venomous hex dealing 0.8x poison damage, plus 8% poison DoT for 4 turns. Reduces the target's healing received by 30%.

abilities.name: Shatter Ward
abilities.description: Shatters an enemy's defenses, reducing Physical and Magic DEF by 30% for 3 turns and removing one active buff.

abilities.name: Spreading Curse
abilities.description: Spreads a virulent curse to all enemies, dealing 1x dark damage, inflicting dark DoT for 3 turns, and reducing all resistances by 10%.

abilities.name: Maleficence
abilities.description: Passive: All debuffs last 1 additional turn. Deal 20% bonus damage to enemies afflicted by any debuff. Gain 10% additional Dark Resistance.

abilities.name: Doom
abilities.description: Ultimate: Places Doom on a single enemy — reduces all stats and resistances by 20% for 3 turns. When Doom expires, the target takes 4x Magic ATK as dark damage.

synergies: Necromancer: Resistance reduction makes the Necromancer's dark damage even more devastating
Elementalist: Shattered wards and reduced resistances let elemental attacks hit at full force
Rogue: Defense shredding enables massive physical burst damage from Rogue backstabs
weaknesses: Very low direct damage output — relies on allies to capitalize on debuffs
Fragile with low STA and no defensive abilities
Debuffs are less effective against bosses with debuff resistance
Holy damage exploits the Witch's negative holy resistance
Doom is wasted if the target dies before the counter expires
hire_description: A cloaked figure stirs a bubbling cauldron that wasn't there a moment ago. Something writhes in the smoke above it. They flash a crooked grin. "Everyone brings a sword to the dungeon. I bring something worse — bad luck."
